تلتبسوا (form VIII)
# تَلْتَبِسُوا (taltabisū) /tal.ta.bi.suː/: second-person masculine plural non-past active subjunctive/jussive of اِلْتَبَسَ (iltabasa)
# تُلْتَبَسُوا (tultabasū) /tul.ta.ba.suː/: second-person masculine plural non-past passive subjunctive/jussive of اِلْتَبَسَ (iltabasa)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
